heading: The Process
intro: What happens from your first message to your first session.

steps.title: Initial Enquiry
steps.description: Fill in the contact form or send me an email. Everything you send is kept confidential, and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.description: We'll start with a free 20-minute call, so you can ask questions and we can see whether I'm the right therapist for you.

steps.title: Begin Treatment
steps.description: We'll book sessions at times that suit you. Together we'll agree what you want from therapy and check in regularly on how it's going.
